verdict: Yes. Phitku pitched alum-based natural deodorants on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Alum (phitkari) is a traditional Indian remedy for body odour, and natural deodorants appeal to buyers avoiding chemicals.
angle: Alum blocks and sprays are cheap to make and sell to buyers who want natural, aluminium-free or fragrance-free options. Education on how to use them helps buyers switch.
